description: This Java class 'Allergies' represents patient allergy data within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It implements the List interface to manage a collection of 'Allergy' objects, providing methods to add, remove, and query allergies, as well as custom logic to prevent duplicate allergens and track allergy status.

classes.name: Allergies
classes.description: Represents a collection of patient allergies with logic to manage allergy data and prevent duplicate allergens.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new allergy to the list, enforcing no duplicate allergens and updating the allergy status to 'See list'.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an allergy from the list and updates the status if the list becomes empty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all allergies and resets the allergy status to 'Unknown'.

methods.name: confirmNoKnownAllergies
methods.description: Marks the allergies as 'No known allergies' if the list is empty; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: getAllergy
methods.description: Retrieves a specific allergy by its ID.

methods.name: containsAllergen
methods.description: Checks if an allergy with the same allergen exists in the collection.
